values.binNote: No bin row carries 25/50/75 or 0.15 directly: this is the wiki's precomputed per-stack contribution, equal to DariusExecute#Damage (RBaseDamage + 0.75x bonus AD) multiplied by RDamagePercentPerHemoStack=0.2 (i.e. 0.2*125=25, 0.2*250=50, 0.2*375=75, and 0.2*0.75=0.15 bonus AD coef). The bin stores the 20%-per-stack multiplier once (RDamagePercentPerHemoStack) rather than as five precomputed flat/ratio numbers; r_1's damage is scaled by (1 + 0.2*stacks, capped at 1.0) rather than this row being added as a separate instance.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast, not on hit.
Damage is true damage, increased 20% per Hemorrhage stack on the target, capped at 100% bonus at 5 stacks.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|type=target's [[File:Hemorrhage.png|20px]] Hemorrhage stacks|key=%|0 to 100 by 20|0 to 5|formula=20% for every Hemorrhage stack the target has, capped at 100% at 5 stacks}}

mechanics.claim: Noxian Guillotine applies Hemorrhage (its stacking bleed debuff) after the damage lands, so the hit itself is not affected by the stack it applies.
Darius leaps to the target to deliver the strike; the leap does not change that the target is still hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Darius''' will only leap towards the target if it is at range, or leap backwards if it is very close.

mechanics.claim: If the target dies shortly after being hit, Darius can recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, and this refreshes on further successful executions.
mechanics.quote: He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.

mechanics.claim: At max rank (rank 3), Noxian Guillotine has no mana cost and no recast timer restriction.
mechanics.quote: At rank 3, ''Noxian Guillotine'' has no {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and recast timer.

mechanics.claim: Darius cannot cast Decimate or Apprehend for a short window after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''''Darius''' is unable to cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.''
